cases.task: Write a short project update for the client using only these facts: I reviewed the first two screens; the third screen is still waiting on their copy; I can finish the review by Thursday if it arrives by Tuesday; otherwise I will send a revised date. Keep the client responsible for supplying the copy, preserve the conditional timing, and do not imply that the whole project is nearly finished. Source text: ‘I reviewed screens one and two. Screen three is waiting for your copy. If it arrives by Tuesday, I can finish the review by Thursday; otherwise I’ll send a revised date.’
cases.sourceText: I reviewed screens one and two. Screen three is waiting for your copy. If it arrives by Tuesday, I can finish the review by Thursday; otherwise I’ll send a revised date.

obligations.question: Who must supply the copy?
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Screen three is waiting for your copy.

obligations.question: What condition makes Thursday completion possible?
obligations.expectedAnswer: The copy must arrive by Tuesday.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: If it arrives by Tuesday, I can finish the review by Thursday

obligations.question: What happens if the copy does not arrive by Tuesday?
obligations.expectedAnswer: The sender will provide a revised date.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: otherwise I’ll send a revised date.

cases.operation: Rewrite as a concise, clear client update.
usefulnessCriteria: Clearly states that the client needs to provide the copy.
Keeps Thursday dependent on receiving it by Tuesday.
Retains the fallback of sending a revised date.
Does not overstate completion of the wider project.

cases.task: Check this sentence for the requested change. It is already clear and correct, so keep it unchanged unless a genuine error requires correction. Source text: ‘We have not confirmed the venue yet.’
cases.sourceText: We have not confirmed the venue yet.

obligations.question: What does ‘yet’ establish?
obligations.expectedAnswer: Confirmation remains outstanding at the time of writing.

usefulnessCriteria: Does not turn the pending status into a decision or promise.

cases.task: Rewrite the note to make the action and timing easier to follow. Preserve that Mara owns the review, the sender owns the file update, and approval is not guaranteed. Source text: ‘Mara review the figures. I’ll change file after she tell me. If all okay, maybe we can send Friday.’
cases.sourceText: Mara review the figures. I’ll change file after she tell me. If all okay, maybe we can send Friday.

obligations.question: Who changes the file, and when?
obligations.expectedAnswer: The sender changes it after Mara reports back.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: I’ll change file after she tell me.

obligations.question: Is sending on Friday definite?
obligations.expectedAnswer: No; Friday is only a possibility if everything is satisfactory.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: If all okay, maybe we can send Friday.

cases.operation: Edit for clear grammar and sequence while preserving the uncertainty.
usefulnessCriteria: Fixes grammar and makes the sequence readable.
Keeps Mara responsible for review and the sender responsible for changing the file.
Frames Friday sending as conditional and tentative.

cases.task: Turn this into a short service notice. Preserve the normal rule and the specific exception for existing bookings; do not imply that new bookings are affected. Source text: ‘The studio closes at 5 pm on Mondays. Existing bookings on 23 June can still run until 6 pm because the building manager approved a one-off extension. New bookings cannot be added after 5 pm.’
cases.sourceText: The studio closes at 5 pm on Mondays. Existing bookings on 23 June can still run until 6 pm because the building manager approved a one-off extension. New bookings cannot be added after 5 pm.

obligations.question: What is the studio’s usual Monday closing time?
obligations.sourceExcerpt: The studio closes at 5 pm on Mondays.

obligations.question: Which bookings may run until 6 pm, and on what date?
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Existing bookings on 23 June can still run until 6 pm

obligations.question: Can a new booking be added after 5 pm?
obligations.sourceExcerpt: New bookings cannot be added after 5 pm.

cases.operation: Condense into a clear notice without losing the exception.
usefulnessCriteria: States the usual Monday 5 pm closing time.
Preserves the one-off extension for existing bookings on 23 June only.
States that new bookings cannot be added after 5 pm.

controls.sourceExcerpt: Please send the signed form by 3 pm on Tuesday so I can submit it that afternoon.
